### Demo 5 — NetworkPolicy isolation, with a control
-- policies in force:
NAME                        POD-SELECTOR
allow-alb-to-frontend       map[app:frontend]
allow-app-egress            <none>
allow-dns-egress            <none>
allow-frontend-to-backend   map[app:backend]
default-deny                <none>
-- worker pod age (must be > ~2m for this probe to mean anything):
NAME                      AGE
worker-77b8d8bd47-9k89l   2026-08-03T18:11:24Z
-- real probe: worker -> backend:5000 (must NOT connect):
   BLOCKED by NetworkPolicy: TimeoutError
-- control: worker -> RDS:5432 (must connect — allow-app-egress permits it):
   RDS REACHABLE (the probe works)
